title: Concept: Dependency declared only by exclusions
description: package.json declares a specifier that names only versions to exclude, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An exclusion-only declaration accepts every other release, including every future one, so the dependency is effectively unbounded.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: An exclusion-only declaration accepts every other release, including every future one, so the dependency is effectively unbounded.
